# ChargeWatch notice

The optional Apple Silicon battery charge-protection helper contains a
refactored implementation derived from the SMC access pattern and CHTE/CHIE
charge-control strategy in **ChargeWatch** by **TY-teo**.

- Upstream project: https://github.com/TY-teo/ChargeWatching
- Upstream copyright: Copyright (c) 2026 TY-teo
- Upstream license: MIT License (included in `LICENSE`)

Only the limited charging-control concepts needed by this project are used.
The ChargeWatch application, its UI, and its periodic automatic full-charge
feature are not included.
